note: Charlton County recreation area on the St. Marys River near Folkston (1388 Tracys Ferry Rd), by the Okefenokee NWR; sites in open woods a short walk from the river, boat ramp and fishing pier. Some sites share a sewer connection. CAMPER-REPORTED RATE: $30 water/electric, $35 full hookup (Campendium review, February 2024; $30 paid November 2025); the county has no web page for the park (2026-10-29). Camper review October 2026: bathhouse 'very filthy and in severe disrepair'. --Claude
summary: Charlton County's website (CivicPlus) has no page for Traders Hill - Parks & Recreation lists only sports programs - and no booking channel exists, so it was priced from dated camper reports per AWH 2026-10-11: $30 W/E, $35 full hookup (Feb 2024; $30 Nov 2025), reported. Sewer at some sites (reported), FCFS/no reservations (reported). Count/electric left (only aggregator evidence). Imagery: the loop sits in woods ~250-350 m south-west of the St. Marys and the ramp - stored 'not waterfront' agrees, no lead. Pin on the loop. Website/phone - see flags.
flags: Website: https://www.charltoncountyga.us/ is the county's home page and carries no page for the park (no agency page exists that we could find; Explore Georgia's tourism listing is the only official-looking page). Keep the county home or replace with the Explore Georgia listing - AWH's call.

Phone unconfirmed: stored 912-496-3412 appears only on Campendium; Explore Georgia (state tourism) gives (912) 390-9288, and a Dyrt reviewer says the Dyrt's copy of that number is wrong. The county's Parks & Recreation office is 912-496-7037 (charltoncountyga.us/218). No operator page settles it.
Site count: stored 14 (7 RV + 7 tent) rests on the note; camper reviews name sites 18, 23 and 25 and The Dyrt says ~12, so the count is doubtful but no official source states one - left.
